__broaden__.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’)

__broaden__.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
